lines.trans: Nastya, look at me for one second.
What happened, Kostya?
You have a really cool hairstyle today.
Really? Do you really like it?
Yes, it is so unusual and beautiful.
You have very sweet, soft curls.
Thank you, I took a long time doing this styling.
They are curled like a little lamb's.
What did you just say like that?
I meant a fluffy little lamb.
You are a foolish sheep yourself, got it?
Sorry, I just wanted to make a compliment!
